extracted.intended_audience: astronomers, observatory staff, and readers of historical astronomical observation reports
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and publishing tabulated observatory measurements (dates, barometer/thermometer, microscope readings, culminations, refraction/reduction corrections, and derived means) for celestial objects. The page is an observational data report showing the fields and conventions used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Calendar date for each observation, given as month and day (e.g., 'May 1', 'June 14', 'Sept. 24').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record the observation date in the table heading/row; examples throughout the table: 'May 1', 'June 14', 'Sept. 24', 'Nov. 1', etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Barom. (Barometer reading, inches)
rubrics_metrics.description: Barometer pressure reading listed under the column header 'Barom.' with units 'inches.' (e.g., 29.78, 30.06, 29.85).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the barometric pressure in inches for the date/observation. The table shows many example readings (29.78, 30.05, 29.92, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Therm. / Mean Inside Temperature
rubrics_metrics.description: Thermometer/temperature readings and occasional reported mean inside temperature (e.g., 'Mean Inside Temperature 73°.', 'Mean Inside Temperature 74°.6').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record temperature readings associated with observations and give a mean inside temperature for the observing set when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microscopes I–IV (individual microscope readings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Columns labeled I, II, III, IV (Microscopes) listing individual microscope readings for each observation set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give each microscope's measured value (as appearing under I–IV columns). These individual readings are used to compute the mean of the four microscopes; many example values shown in the table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mean of 4 Microscopes
rubrics_metrics.description: The arithmetic mean (aggregate) of the four microscope readings, reported as 'Mean of 4 Microscopes' often followed by a derived positional value (e.g., 'Mean of 4 Microscopes . 21° 59' 27".25 by 8 Observ.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute and report the mean of microscopes I–IV for a given observing run, and annotate the number of observations used (by N Observ.). Example format and result appear multiple times.

rubrics_metrics.name: Superior Culmination
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported superior culmination values for the observed object (heading 'Superior Culmination' / 'Superior Culminat.'), i.e., measurements when the object reaches upper culmination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the measured superior culmination values (often in degrees/minutes/seconds or specific numeric table columns) for each date/run as shown in table rows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inferior Culmination
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported inferior culmination values for the observed object (heading 'Inferior Culmination' / 'Inferior Culminat.'), i.e., measurements when the object reaches lower culmination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the measured inferior culmination values for each date/run similar to superior culmination entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refract, and Reduct. (Refraction and reduction corrections)
rubrics_metrics.description: Refraction and reduction corrections applied to observed values, labeled 'Refract, and Reduct.' and presented as numeric adjustments (often with sign), e.g., '-4 39.0', '-7.6', '-11.4', '-37.9', '-50.1'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the refraction and reduction correction for the observation set. The table shows these corrections preceding or immediately following mean/cumulative values; include sign and magnitude as printed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Half Diff. S. P. D.
rubrics_metrics.description: A tabulated quantity labeled 'Half Diff. S. P. D.' (appearing as 'Half Diff.  S.  P.  D.' or variations), with numeric triplets/series (e.g., '20 59 25.3', '59 25.6', '59 24.6').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the half-difference statistics (S. P. D. as printed) for the set; the document lists these values in the rows grouped with means and culminations. Use the same format of grouped numeric entries as in the table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mean S. P. D. of object (positional mean and observer count)
rubrics_metrics.description: The mean S.P.D. (as printed: 'Mean S. P. D. of ... Jan. 1, 1828 . 21° 59' 24".93 by 350 Observ.') — a derived mean positional measure for a named object together with the date and number of observations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When summarizing over many observations, report the mean S.P.D. (or equivalent mean) with associated epoch/date and the count of observations used (e.g., 'by 350 Observ.').

rubrics_metrics.name: Observer count / 'by N Observ.'
rubrics_metrics.description: The number of observations or observers contributing to a mean, printed as 'by N Observ.' (e.g., 'by 8 Observ.', 'by 350 Observ.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always state the N used to compute reported means or aggregate statistics; examples appear after 'Mean of 4 Microscopes' and 'Mean S. P. D.' headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units and angular notation (degrees, minutes, seconds; inches)
rubrics_metrics.description: Units used across the tables: 'inches.' for barometer readings and angular notation for positional means (degrees°, minutes', seconds"), and degree-arcminute-arcsecond formats (e.g., '21° 59' 27".25').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistently annotate numeric values with the proper units/notation as in the document: barometer in inches; positional measures in degrees/minutes/seconds with fractional seconds when shown.
